product_metadata.title: Luna King Mattress Protector - Waterproof Mattress Cover w/Absorbent Cotton Terry Surface - Noiseless, Breathable Topper - 100% Sourced & Produced in The USA
features: WATERPROOF - This bed cover doesn't just deliver on comfort - it fully protects against water, sweat, urine, and any other liquids or accidents with ease.
DEEP POCKETS - Big mattress? No big deal. This king mattress protector measures 76” x 80” inches and fits up to 18" pockets to ensure your entire mattress is completely covered.
BREATHABLE - Using Luna AirFlow Technology, our waterproof mattress pad allows air to circulate throughout, so you can stay cool while still protecting your mattress from liquids and debris.
NOISELESS SURFACE - Not only did we make our bed protector waterproof, we designed its cotton terry surface to be totally noiseless, so you can sleep soundly (without making a sound).

details.Product Care Instructions: Machine Wash Tumble Dry Low Heat With Other Bedding Items
